# nemau load-balancer pool

Manage pools, members and health monitors.

## Usage

```
nemau load-balancer pool [command]
```

Alias: `pools`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [add-member](nemau_load-balancer_pool_add-member.md) | Add a member to a pool |
| [add-monitor](nemau_load-balancer_pool_add-monitor.md) | Add a health monitor to a pool |
| [create](nemau_load-balancer_pool_create.md) | Create a pool |
| [delete](nemau_load-balancer_pool_delete.md) | Delete a pool |
| [list](nemau_load-balancer_pool_list.md) | List a load balancer's pools |
| [members](nemau_load-balancer_pool_members.md) | List a pool's members |
| [remove-member](nemau_load-balancer_pool_remove-member.md) | Remove a member from a pool |
| [remove-monitor](nemau_load-balancer_pool_remove-monitor.md) | Remove a health monitor |
| [update](nemau_load-balancer_pool_update.md) | Change a pool's name, description or algorithm |
| [update-member](nemau_load-balancer_pool_update-member.md) | Change a member's name or weight |
| [update-monitor](nemau_load-balancer_pool_update-monitor.md) | Change a health monitor's probe settings |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
